entries.name: Krishnapuram Palace
entries.description: An 18th-century palace built by Marthandavarma Maharaja that houses a museum displaying antique sculptures, paintings, bronzes, and the large Gajendramoksham mural.

entries.name: Pathiramanal Island
entries.description: A small biodiversity island and haven for migratory birds located in Vembanad Lake, accessible exclusively through water.

entries.name: Allahabad Fort
entries.description: Built by Emperor Akbar, the historic Allahabad Fort stands at the confluence of the rivers and offers stunning views of the Sangam.

entries.name: Allahabad Museum
entries.description: Established in 1931 within Chandrashekhar Azad Park, the Allahabad Museum houses a rich collection of sculptures, paintings, archaeological objects, and historical artifacts.

entries.name: Anand Bhavan
entries.description: Anand Bhavan is a historic house museum in Allahabad that served as the ancestral home of the Nehru family and showcases India's freedom struggle.

entries.name: Triveni Sangam
entries.description: Triveni Sangam is the defining spiritual attraction of Allahabad, representing the sacred confluence of the Ganga, Yamuna, and the mythical Saraswati rivers.

entries.name: Bright End Corner
entries.description: A scenic viewpoint situated at the end of the Almora ridge, popular for offering breathtaking views of dawn and dusk.

entries.name: Chitai Golu Devta Temple
entries.description: A famous temple dedicated to Golu Ji, considered an incarnation of Lord Shiva, known for its unique culture and numerous bells.

entries.name: Kasar Devi Temple
entries.description: An ancient and revered temple located in Almora, attracting devotees and visitors for its spiritual significance and peaceful environment.

entries.name: Bala Quila
entries.description: An imposing hilltop fort located in Alwar offering panoramic views of the region.

entries.name: Bhangarh Fort
entries.description: A well-known historic fort located in Alwar, renowned for its ruins and popular folklore.

entries.name: Sariska National Park
entries.description: A prominent national park and tiger reserve in Alwar featuring wildlife and ancient temples.

entries.name: Siliserh Lake
entries.description: A scenic lake near Alwar featuring a historic palace on its banks.

entries.name: Durgiana Temple
entries.description: A prominent Hindu temple in Amritsar dedicated to Goddess Durga, featuring a golden dome and silver doors that resemble the architecture of the Golden Temple.

entries.name: Golden Temple
entries.description: The premier spiritual shrine of Sikhism, also known as Sri Harmandir Sahib, featuring stunning golden architecture located in the heart of Amritsar.

entries.name: Jallianwala Bagh
entries.description: A historical public garden and memorial in Amritsar commemorating the victims of the tragic 1919 massacre, preserving bullet marks and the Martyrs' Well.

entries.name: Wagah Border
entries.description: A road border crossing located near Amritsar famous for its daily patriotic retreat ceremony held between India and Pakistan.

entries.name: Arambol Beach
entries.description: A popular, laid-back coastal beach destination in northern Goa known for its soft sands, clear waters, sunsets, and bohemian atmosphere.

entries.name: Our Lady of Mount Carmel Church
entries.description: A historic church located in the center of Arambol, originally built in 1780 and later reconstructed and renamed in 1841.

entries.name: Sweet Water Lake
entries.description: A serene freshwater lake located near Arambol Beach, surrounded by lush greenery and accessible via a trail over the local mountain and palm groves.

entries.name: Chhatrapati Shivaji Museum
entries.description: A museum dedicated to the life of Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj, featuring 6 halls with photographs, ancient weaponry, armor, coins, and artifacts such as a 400-year-old Paithani sari.

entries.name: Daulatabad Fort
entries.description: Also known as Deogiri Fort, this imposing 12th-century fortification stands 200 metres above sea level and is renowned for its strong defense architecture, Chini Mahal, and Chand Minar.

entries.name: Ellora Caves
entries.description: A stunning UNESCO World Heritage rock-cut temple complex near Aurangabad featuring 34 monasteries and temples representing Buddhist, Hindu, and Jain monuments.

entries.name: Grishneshwar Temple
entries.description: A prominent Jyotirlinga temple located near Aurangabad, known for its religious and architectural significance.

entries.name: Hanuman Garhi
entries.description: Hanuman Garhi is a prominent temple dedicated to Lord Hanuman, featuring a towering statue and panoramic views of Ayodhya.

entries.name: Kanak Bhawan
entries.description: Kanak Bhawan is a finely adorned temple dedicated to Lord Rama and Goddess Sita, known for its ornate architecture and exquisite idols.

entries.name: Nageshwarnath Temple
entries.description: Nageshwarnath Temple is an ancient Shiva temple located near Ram Ki Paidi, said to have been established by Kush, Lord Rama's son.

entries.name: Ram Janmabhoomi
entries.description: Ram Janmabhoomi is believed to be the birthplace of the Hindu deity Lord Ram, featuring a revered temple site.

entries.name: Agastya Lake
entries.description: A large reservoir situated in the valley below the cave temples and in front of the Bhutanatha temples, gracing the landscape of Badami.

entries.name: Archaeological Museum
entries.description: Located near the Agastya Lake complex, this museum features four galleries with sculptures, inscriptions, prehistoric exhibits, and artifacts like the sandstone image of Lajja Gauri.

entries.name: Badami Cave Temples
entries.description: A complex of four rock-cut cave temples located on the southern hill of Badami, dedicated to deities such as Lord Vishnu and Lord Shiva, representing early Chalukyan art.

entries.name: Badami Fort
entries.description: Perched atop a northern hill cliff opposite the Badami Caves, the fort houses large granaries, watchtowers, underground chambers, and temples offering panoramic town views.

entries.name: Baga Beach
entries.description: Situated in North Goa, Baga Beach is named after the Baga Creek that flows into the Arabian Sea and is famous for its vibrant nightlife, seafood, water sports, and bustling bazaar.

entries.name: Basilica of Bom Jesus
entries.description: A UNESCO World Heritage Site in Goa featuring Portuguese heritage, known for holding the remains of St. Francis Xavier.

entries.name: Fort Aguada
entries.description: A 17th-century coastal defense fort and viewpoint in Goa featuring a four-storey lighthouse built in 1864.

entries.name: Se Cathedral
entries.description: Goa's iconic monument from the Portuguese colonial period built in Portuguese-Manueline architectural style, considered one of Asia's largest churches.

entries.name: Cubbon Park
entries.description: A historic urban green space and botanical park spanning roughly 300 acres in central Bengaluru.

entries.name: ISKCON Temple Bangalore
entries.description: A famous religious site and prominent temple in Bengaluru dedicated to Lord Krishna and Radha.

entries.name: Lalbagh Botanical Garden
entries.description: A 240-acre botanical park in the heart of Bengaluru established in 1760, serving as a horticultural research center and major cultural attraction.

entries.name: Visvesvaraya Industrial & Technological Museum
entries.description: An educational museum located near Cubbon Park featuring exhibits related to science, technology, engineering, and industry.

entries.name: Bhimbetka Rock Shelters
entries.description: The Bhimbetka Rock Shelters are a UNESCO World Heritage Site in Madhya Pradesh known for ancient cave paintings that are over 30,000 years old.

entries.name: Madhya Pradesh Tribal Museum
entries.description: The Madhya Pradesh Tribal Museum in Bhopal is a cultural institution that celebrates and showcases the rich tribal art and culture of the region.

entries.name: Taj-ul-Masjid
entries.description: Taj-ul-Masjid is one of the biggest mosques in India, noted for its massive scale and peaceful atmosphere in Bhopal.

entries.name: Van Vihar National Park
entries.description: Van Vihar National Park is a prominent national park and open zoological park located along the Upper Lake in Bhopal, offering an open zoo experience blending nature and wildlife.

entries.name: Lingaraj Temple
entries.description: An 11th-century Hindu shrine and one of the largest and oldest temples in Bhubaneswar, dedicated to Lord Shiva.

entries.name: Nandankanan Zoological Park
entries.description: A prominent zoo located in Bhubaneswar known for its wildlife including tigers, white tigers, and lions.

entries.name: Odisha State Museum
entries.description: A premier museum in Bhubaneswar featuring exhibits spanning multiple floors on archaeology, geology, armory, and local artifacts.

entries.name: Udayagiri and Khandagiri Caves
entries.description: Ancient rock-cut caves located near Bhubaneswar featuring historical and archaeological significance.

entries.name: Aina Mahal
entries.description: A historical palace in Bhuj known as the Palace of Mirrors, featuring a dazzling display of mirrors and multicoloured glass.

entries.name: Hamirsar Lake
entries.description: A historic lake located in the heart of Bhuj, ideal for peaceful walks and birdwatching.

entries.name: Kutch Museum
entries.description: The oldest museum in Gujarat, located in Bhuj, housing a vast collection of tribal artifacts, ancient weapons, and archaeological finds.

entries.name: Prag Mahal
entries.description: An architectural landmark in Bhuj showcasing Italian Gothic influences, complete with a grand durbar hall and a tall clock tower.

entries.name: Ganga Singh Museum
entries.description: A renowned museum in Bikaner displaying archaeological findings, art, craft, terracotta, and weaponry.

entries.name: Junagarh Fort
entries.description: A major historical and heritage fort located in Bikaner, Rajasthan.

entries.name: Lalgarh Palace
entries.description: A royal palace and museum located in Bikaner.

entries.name: National Research Centre on Camel
entries.description: A fine place located in Bikaner to study and see camels.

entries.name: Benz Celebrity Wax Museum
entries.description: A speciality museum in Calangute displaying celebrity wax statues alongside a 9D cinema and dashing cars game.

entries.name: Calangute Beach
entries.description: A famous beach in Calangute known for water sports, sun, sand, and endless vibes.

entries.name: St. Alex Church
entries.description: A notable church in Calangute where history meets serenity.

entries.name: All About Alcohol Museum
entries.description: A history museum located in Candolim that showcases unique exhibits related to alcohol.

entries.name: Candolim Beach
entries.description: A popular beach in North Goa known for its pristine sands, clear waters, and quiet ambiance, offering water sports, beach shacks, and sunset views.

entries.name: Fort Aguada
entries.description: A 17th-century Portuguese fort and historical site resting on a hilltop overlooking the Arabian Sea, featuring well-preserved ramparts and a lighthouse.

entries.name: Sinquerim Beach
entries.description: A twin beach to Candolim featuring red sands, rocky headlands, and a beachfront near Fort Aguada.

entries.name: Capitol Complex
entries.description: A UNESCO World Heritage Site designed by Le Corbusier, symbolizing Chandigarh's architectural brilliance and including the High Court, Secretariat, and Legislative Assembly.

entries.name: Open Hand Monument
entries.description: An 85-foot-tall landmark designed by Le Corbusier that serves as the official emblem of Chandigarh and a symbol of peace, reconciliation, and unity.

entries.name: Rock Garden
entries.description: A famous sculpture garden in Chandigarh constructed completely of recycled materials such as shattered pottery, bangles, and tiles.

entries.name: Fort St. George
entries.description: Dating back to 1644, Fort St. George holds the distinction of being the first English fortress in India and houses the Tamil Nadu Legislative Assembly and the Fort Museum in Chennai.

entries.name: Government Museum
entries.description: Widely regarded as the best in Chennai, the Government Museum is a treasure trove of artefacts showcasing the region's rich past, including a famous bronze gallery containing Chola dynasty statues.

entries.name: Kapaleeshwarar Temple
entries.description: Dedicated to Lord Shiva, this prominent temple in Chennai showcases magnificent Dravidian-style architecture, adorned with intricate sculptures and towering gopurams.

entries.name: Marina Beach
entries.description: Marina Beach stands out as one of the longest urban beaches globally, offering stunning views of the Bay of Bengal and serving as a favourite spot for locals and tourists alike in Chennai.

entries.name: Arwah Cave
entries.description: A cave located near Cherrapunji featuring fossil formations along its walls as well as stalactites and stalagmites.

entries.name: Mawsmai Cave
entries.description: A popular limestone cave in Cherrapunji featuring stalactite and stalagmite formations, accessible to visitors for exploration.

entries.name: Nongsawlia Presbyterian Church
entries.description: An iconic historic church in Cherrapunji built by Welsh missionaries in the late 19th century, featuring a rustic stone facade and quaint wooden interiors.

entries.name: Thangkharang Park
entries.description: A park located near Cherrapunji offering panoramic viewpoints of the Bangladesh plains and the three-tiered Kynrem Falls, close to the Khoh Ramhah rock.

entries.name: Cherai Beach
entries.description: A famous beach located around 25 km from Kochi that comes under Vypin Island.

entries.name: Hill Palace Museum
entries.description: Built in 1865 as the residence of the Cochin kings in the Tripunithura district, it is now Kerala's largest archaeological museum, housing Keralan archaeological and royal artifacts set in 52 acres of gardens.

entries.name: Mangalavanam Bird Sanctuary
entries.description: An ecologically sensitive area situated at the center of the city of Kochi, covering about 2.74 hectares.

entries.name: Santa Cruz Basilica
entries.description: A historic Roman Catholic church and cathedral located in Fort Kochi, known for its stunning architecture and historical significance.

entries.name: Adiyogi Shiva Statue
entries.description: A notable landmark and massive 112-foot bust of Adiyogi located at the Isha Yoga Center in Coimbatore.

entries.name: Gass Forest Museum
entries.description: A century-old natural history museum managed by the local government, featuring a diverse collection of preserved flora and fauna specimens.

entries.name: Marudhamalai Hill Temple
entries.description: A 12th-century hilltop temple constructed by Tamil monarchs in the Western Ghats, devoted to Lord Murugan.

entries.name: Perur Pateeswarar Temple
entries.description: An ancient Hindu temple dedicated to Lord Shiva, built in the second century CE by Karikala Chola in the western part of Coimbatore.

entries.name: Barabati Fort
entries.description: An ancient 14th-century fort ruins located in Cuttack overlooking the Mahanadi River, featuring an impressive stone-carved entrance.

entries.name: Cuttack Chandi Temple
entries.description: A revered temple in Cuttack dedicated to the presiding deity Goddess Chandi, drawing large crowds particularly during Durga Puja.

entries.name: Netaji Birth Place Museum
entries.description: Located in Oriya Bazaar, Cuttack, this is the ancestral home and birthplace of freedom fighter Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose, converted into a museum detailing his life.

entries.name: Odisha Maritime Museum
entries.description: A museum in Cuttack showcasing the rich maritime history, boat-building, and navigation traditions of Odisha.

entries.name: Kalatop Wildlife Sanctuary
entries.description: A serene sanctuary located in Dalhousie, Himachal Pradesh, known for its diverse flora and fauna, including the Himalayan black bear and various bird species.

entries.name: Satdhara Falls
entries.description: A natural waterfall located in Dalhousie, Himachal Pradesh, known for its picturesque surroundings and scenic beauty.

entries.name: St. John's Church
entries.description: A historic colonial-era Protestant church built in 1863 in Dalhousie featuring a unique blend of Gothic and British architectural styles.

entries.name: Subhash Baoli
entries.description: A peaceful natural spring in Dalhousie named after Subhash Chandra Bose, offering views of snow-capped mountains and long walking paths.

entries.name: Happy Valley Tea Estate
entries.description: A well-known tea estate in Darjeeling offering scenic views of lush green plantations and processing yards, representing the region's famous tea culture.

entries.name: Himalayan Mountaineering Institute
entries.description: Founded in Darjeeling in 1953 to celebrate Tenzing Norgay's successful summit of Mount Everest with Edmund Hillary, serving as a prominent training site for climbers.

entries.name: Japanese Peace Pagoda
entries.description: A serene Buddhist temple in Darjeeling built on the slopes of Jalaphar Hill, featuring a domed roof, gilded statues, ornate carvings, and stunning views of the valley.

entries.name: Padmaja Naidu Himalayan Zoological Park
entries.description: India's highest and most extensive zoo, established in Darjeeling in 1958, dedicated to the preservation of endangered Himalayan species such as snow leopards and Tibetan wolves.

entries.name: Forest Research Institute
entries.description: A prominent colonial landmark and institution in Dehradun featuring striking architecture and museums.

entries.name: Mindrolling Monastery
entries.description: A large and extravagant Buddhist monastery in Dehradun housing the Great Stupa, beautiful murals, and peaceful meditation spaces.

entries.name: Robber's Cave
entries.description: A natural river cave formation located in Dehradun, known locally as Gucchu Paani, offering scenic beauty for visitors.

entries.name: Sahastradhara
entries.description: A popular tourist attraction and waterfall near Dehradun known for its natural beauty and therapeutic sulfur springs.

entries.name: India Gate
entries.description: A 42-meter-high historic war memorial and vast public park located in the heart of Delhi.

entries.name: Lotus Temple
entries.description: An edifice of the Bahai faith in Delhi constructed purely with white marble and designed in the shape of a lotus flower.

entries.name: Qutub Minar
entries.description: A 72-metre Mughal Era monument in Delhi featuring a nearby lush green lawn suitable for family picnics.

entries.name: Red Fort
entries.description: A magnificent red sandstone structure in Delhi featuring expansive complexes and well-preserved Mughal relics inside its museum.

entries.name: Amarabati Park
entries.description: A recreational park in Digha featuring green surroundings, a lake with boating facilities, and a ropeway ride.

entries.name: Digha Science Centre & National Science Camp
entries.description: A science center in Digha featuring interactive experiments, magic shows, and dinosaur displays suitable for visitors and families.

entries.name: Marine Aquarium and Regional Centre
entries.description: An aquarium center located in Digha featuring a variety of freshwater and marine life.

entries.name: New Digha Beach
entries.description: A clean, well-maintained beach in Digha offering magnificent views of sunrises and sunsets.

entries.name: Bhadkeshwar Mahadev Temple
entries.description: A unique seaside temple dedicated to Lord Shiva that gets completely submerged by the sea during the monsoons.

entries.name: Dwarkadhish Temple
entries.description: Also known as Jagat Mandir, this towering 5-storied Hindu pilgrimage destination is dedicated to Lord Krishna and is a part of the Char Dham yatra.

entries.name: Nageshwar Jyotirlinga
entries.description: One of Lord Shiva's 12 sacred Jyotirlingas, featuring a prominent 80-foot or 25-meter tall Shiva statue.

entries.name: Rukmini Devi Temple
entries.description: An ancient temple dedicated to Rukmini, featuring intricate carvings and paintings that tell the story of her separation from Lord Krishna.

entries.name: Hanuman Tok
entries.description: A famous temple in Gangtok dedicated to Lord Hanuman, situated at an altitude of 7,200 feet and offering views of the Kanchenjunga peak.

entries.name: Namgyal Institute of Tibetology
entries.description: A Tibet museum in Gangtok, Sikkim, featuring a research center, library, and a large collection of Tibetan works and artifacts.

entries.name: Nathu La Pass
entries.description: One of the highest motorable roads in the world, located at a distance from Gangtok in Sikkim.

entries.name: Tsomgo Lake
entries.description: A tranquil glacial lake located in Sikkim, near Gangtok, surrounded by majestic mountain scenery.

entries.name: Koti Tirtha
entries.description: A sacred water tank used for holy dips and bathing rituals, surrounded by various temples in Gokarna.

entries.name: Mahabaleshwara Temple
entries.description: A historic Hindu temple dedicated to Lord Shiva, housing the revered Atmalinga and built in fine Dravidian architecture.

entries.name: Mirjan Fort
entries.description: A historical fort spread over several hectares and built using laterite stones in the Uttara Kannada region near Gokarna.

entries.name: Om Beach
entries.description: A popular scenic beach in Gokarna named for its distinctive coastline shape resembling the auspicious Om symbol, offering water sports and natural beauty.

entries.name: Assam State Museum
entries.description: One of Guwahati's leading cultural attractions, serving as an ideal place to explore the state's rich cultural identity and history.

entries.name: Kamakhya Temple
entries.description: One of the most significant spiritual destinations and Shakti Peeths in India, situated on the Nilachal hills, offering panoramic views of Guwahati and the Brahmaputra River.

entries.name: Srimanta Sankaradeva Kalakshetra
entries.description: A cultural institution in Panjabari, Guwahati, named after the medieval reformer Srimanta Sankardev, featuring a museum, library, art gallery, and children's park.

entries.name: Umananda Temple
entries.description: A 16th-century temple located on Peacock Island in the middle of the Brahmaputra River, dedicated to Lord Shiva and accessible via ferry boat.

entries.name: Gujari Mahal Museum
entries.description: Housed within the historic Gujari Mahal, this museum showcases a vast collection of sculptures, ancient artifacts, and relics offering insight into Gwalior's rich history.

entries.name: Gwalior Fort
entries.description: Perched high on a vast rocky massif, Gwalior Fort is a historic golden sandstone fortress overlooking the city of Gwalior and is regarded as one of the most impregnable fortresses in north and central India.

entries.name: Jai Vilas Palace
entries.description: Built in 1874 by Jayajirao Scindia, the Maharaja of Gwalior, this European-inspired nineteenth-century palace features extensive royal rooms and houses the Scindia Museum.

entries.name: Teli ka Mandir
entries.description: Built in the ninth century by Pratihara emperor Mihira Bhoja, Teli ka Mandir is an ancient temple within the Gwalior Fort complex featuring a unique blend of architectural styles.

entries.name: Lotus Mahal
entries.description: An elegant structure located within the royal enclosure of Hampi that showcases unique Indo-Islamic architectural styles.

entries.name: Matanga Hill
entries.description: A hill in Hampi that visitors hike to the summit of for breathtaking panoramic views of the surrounding ruins and landscape.

entries.name: Vijaya Vittala Temple
entries.description: A renowned 15th-century Hindu temple complex in Hampi dedicated to Lord Vitthala, featuring the famous Stone Chariot and musical pillars.

entries.name: Virupaksha Temple
entries.description: A 7th-century Shiva temple dedicated to Lord Shiva, located in Hampi, serving as the main center of pilgrimage and still used for active worship.

entries.name: Bharat Mata Mandir
entries.description: Bharat Mata Mandir is a multi-story temple in Haridwar dedicated to India as a nation, honoring freedom fighters, historical rulers, and cultural icons.

entries.name: Har Ki Pauri
entries.description: Har Ki Pauri is considered one of the most sacred ghats in Haridwar and India where thousands of devotees take a holy dip and witness the daily Ganga Aarti ceremony.

entries.name: Mansa Devi Temple
entries.description: Mansa Devi Temple is a revered hilltop temple dedicated to Goddess Mansa Devi, offering a popular spiritual destination in Haridwar.

entries.name: Rajaji National Park
entries.description: Rajaji National Park is a protected area spanning the Haridwar region, famous for its rich flora and fauna including Asian elephants, tigers, and leopards.

entries.name: Annapurna Temple
entries.description: An ornate temple in Indore dedicated to the Hindu goddess Annapurna, renowned for its elaborate facade, gilded gate, and southern or Dravidian architectural style.

entries.name: Kanch Mandir
entries.description: A renowned Jain temple in Indore known as the Glass Temple, featuring intricate glasswork, mirrors, mosaics, and cut-glass chandeliers throughout the interior.

entries.name: Lal Bagh Palace
entries.description: One of the grandest monuments from the Holkar Dynasty in Indore, featuring entrance gates that are replicas of those at Buckingham Palace and blending various architectural influences.

entries.name: Rajwada Palace
entries.description: An iconic historical landmark and architectural marvel in Indore built over two centuries ago, spanning seven floors and blending Maratha, European, and Mughal architectural elements.

entries.name: Albert Hall Museum
entries.description: Rajasthan's oldest museum located in Ram Niwas Garden, housed in a classic Indo-Saracenic building with impressive cultural collections.

entries.name: Amber Fort
entries.description: A grand hilltop fort and palace showcasing the architectural grandeur and regal charm of Jaipur, Rajasthan.

entries.name: City Palace
entries.description: A magnificent palace complex situated in the heart of Jaipur, featuring museums, courtyards, and royal collections.

entries.name: Hawa Mahal
entries.description: An iconic architectural landmark in Jaipur known as the Palace of Winds, featuring hundreds of beautifully designed windows.

entries.name: Jal Mahal
entries.description: A picturesque palace located in the center of Man Sagar Lake, showcasing impressive Rajput architecture.

entries.name: Jantar Mantar
entries.description: An important astronomical observatory built by Maharaja Sawai Jai Singh II, containing the largest stone sundial in the world.

entries.name: Gadsisar Lake
entries.description: A picturesque lake fringed by temples, cenotaphs, and ghats that offers tranquil strolls, paddleboat rides, and hosts a laser water show depicting the history of Jaisalmer.

entries.name: Jaisalmer Fort
entries.description: Built in 1156 AD on Meru Hill by Maharaja Jaisal Singh, this iconic yellow sandstone fort is also known as Sonar Qila or the Golden Fort and is a living fort where a quarter of the population resides.

entries.name: Jaisalmer War Museum
entries.description: A museum dedicated to the military history and heroes of India, located in Jaisalmer.

entries.name: Kuldhara Village
entries.description: An abandoned and mysterious village situated in the Thar Desert that was originally inhabited by Brahmins and is known for its eerie and intriguing legends.

entries.name: Jaswant Thada
entries.description: A white marble memorial and royal cremation ground nicknamed the Taj Mahal of Marwar, built in the style of a temple and enclosed by a lush garden.

entries.name: Mandore Gardens
entries.description: Located in the former capital of Marwar, Mandore Gardens are adorned with cenotaphs, temples, and the Hall of Heroes showcasing statues of Rajput heroes and deities.

entries.name: Mehrangarh Fort
entries.description: Perched atop a rocky hill, Mehrangarh Fort is one of the largest and most magnificent forts in India, housing several palaces, museums, and courtyards with panoramic views of the city.

entries.name: Umaid Bhawan Palace
entries.description: A symbol of opulence and grandeur, Umaid Bhawan Palace is one of the world's largest private residences, blending Art Deco and Rajput architectural styles and housing a museum.

entries.name: Delo Park
entries.description: Perched on Deolo Hill at 1,704 meters above sea level, Delo Park offers panoramic 360-degree views of surrounding valleys, rivers, and snow-capped peaks, along with well-maintained gardens.

entries.name: Geden Tharpa Choling Monastery
entries.description: Established in 1912, this monastery is a spiritual sanctuary and center for Gelugpa Buddhism featuring unique murals, traditional art, and a museum showcasing rare artifacts and sacred relics.

entries.name: Lepcha Museum
entries.description: Founded by Padmashree Sonam Tshering, this unique museum is dedicated to the cultural heritage of the Lepcha community, housing musical instruments, manuscripts, and handicraft items.

entries.name: Mangal Dham Temple
entries.description: A prominent temple in Kalimpong featuring serene surroundings, daily prayers, and well-maintained temple gardens that offer peaceful spaces for meditation and scenic views.

entries.name: Kargil War Memorial
entries.description: The Kargil War Memorial, also known as the Drass War Memorial, is situated in Drass and commemorates the Kargil War of 1999, paying tribute to the brave soldiers who sacrificed their lives.

entries.name: Mulbekh Monastery
entries.description: An ancient monastery located in the Kargil region known for its unique location and architectural significance.

entries.name: Rangdum Monastery
entries.description: An age-old monastery in the Kargil region that resembles a fort, perched atop a mountain on an outcrop.

entries.name: Tiger Hill
entries.description: A prominent peak near the Kargil War Memorial offering breathtaking views of the surrounding mountains and a significant site associated with the Kargil conflict.

entries.name: Christ Church
entries.description: A historic colonial-era church built by the British in 1853, famous for its stained glass windows and neo-gothic architecture.

entries.name: Gilbert Trail
entries.description: A popular trekking route in Kasauli that takes you through thick pine forests and offers panoramic views of the surrounding valleys.

entries.name: Gurkha Fort
entries.description: A historic landmark and imposing structure situated at a height of 4500 feet, built in the 19th century by the Gurkha army.

entries.name: Manki Point
entries.description: A small temple dedicated to Lord Hanuman perched atop a hill at 6500 feet, overlooking scenic mountains and valleys.

entries.name: Celebrity Wax Museum
entries.description: A popular wax museum featuring various celebrity statues in the Khandala area.

entries.name: Duke's Nose
entries.description: A natural attraction and popular trekking spot in Khandala offering scenic views.

entries.name: Kune Waterfalls
entries.description: A stunning natural water attraction located in the Khandala and Lonavala region.

entries.name: Rajmachi Fort
entries.description: A historic fort near Khandala reflecting the grandeur of nature and Shivaji's era.

entries.name: Bryant Park
entries.description: A botanical garden located close to Kodaikanal Lake featuring beautifully laid out lawns, hundreds of species of trees, plants, and shrubs, and an annual horticulture show.

entries.name: Coaker's Walk
entries.description: A scenic pedestrian pathway near Kodaikanal Lake offering mystic walks among the clouds and panoramic views for nature enthusiasts.

entries.name: Kodaikanal Lake
entries.description: A star-shaped artificial lake in Kodaikanal popular for boating and scenic surroundings.

entries.name: Silver Cascade Falls
entries.description: A picturesque waterfall located approximately 8 kilometers from Kodaikanal, cascading amidst lush green forests and misty hills.

entries.name: Howrah Bridge
entries.description: A iconic cantilever structure that carries traffic over the Hooghly River in West Bengal and is among the most popular tourist sites in Kolkata.

entries.name: Indian Museum
entries.description: Founded in 1814, Kolkata's Indian Museum is India's oldest and largest museum, hosting a vast collection of historical artifacts, artwork, fossils, and natural history specimens.

entries.name: Kalighat Kali Temple
entries.description: Built in 1809 and dedicated to the goddess Kali, this temple is Kolkata's most important Hindu site and a major point of pilgrimage.

entries.name: Victoria Memorial
entries.description: A large marble building built between 1906 and 1921 dedicated to Queen Victoria, functioning as a museum showcasing the history of the British Raj and surrounded by English-style gardens.

entries.name: Halcyon Castle
entries.description: Also known as the Kovalam Palace, Halcyon Castle is a colonial architectural marvel in Kovalam that has been converted into a luxurious heritage hotel.

entries.name: Hawa Beach
entries.description: Also known as Eve's Beach, Hawa Beach is located immediately south of Lighthouse Beach and is well known for its tranquil sea views and water sports like snorkeling and parasailing.

entries.name: Lighthouse Beach
entries.description: Lighthouse Beach is one of Kovalam's main highlights, featuring the old Vizhinjam lighthouse at its southern end and offering great vantage points for swimming, sunbathing, and photography.

entries.name: Vizhinjam Rock-Cut Cave Temple
entries.description: An ancient Hindu shrine dedicated to Lord Shiva that reflects India's rich cultural heritage through its rock-cut sculptures.

entries.name: Leh Palace
entries.description: A historic royal palace overlooking Leh town that offers stunning views of the surrounding mountains.

entries.name: Pangong Lake
entries.description: A bright blue brackish lake sitting at 14,270 feet above sea level that spans the border between Ladakh and Western Tibet.

entries.name: Shanti Stupa
entries.description: A pointed white dome on a rocky hill in Leh providing panoramic views across the town and surrounding mountains.

entries.name: Thiksey Monastery
entries.description: A 15th-century working Buddhist monastery in Ladakh known for its angular whitewashed brick buildings that resemble the Potala Palace.

entries.name: Ambedkar Memorial Park
entries.description: An expansive 107-acre park in Lucknow featuring grand statues, well-manicured lawns, and an imposing stupa-like hemispherical structure.

entries.name: Bara Imambara
entries.description: A historic heritage site and landmark in Lucknow known for holding the world's largest unsupported arched hall.

entries.name: Dilkusha Kothi
entries.description: A Baroque-styled structure that was originally a hunting lodge and later transformed into a summer palace for the nawabs.

entries.name: Rumi Darwaza
entries.description: An iconic architectural landmark and monument in Lucknow popular for capturing stunning photos.

entries.name: Abbey Falls
entries.description: A scenic waterfall dropping 70 feet near Madikeri, surrounded by lush coffee estates and plantations with a hanging bridge above the falls.

entries.name: Madikeri Fort
entries.description: A major historic heritage attraction and defensive palace located in Madikeri featuring a museum that exhibits fascinating artefacts and relics from the town's past.

entries.name: Omkareshwara Temple
entries.description: A famous temple in Madikeri built in 1820 by King Lingarajendra that reflects a blend of Islamic and Gothic architectural styles.

entries.name: Raja’s Seat
entries.description: A well-known tourist attraction in Madikeri featuring wonderful views of rich valleys, hills, and sunsets, along with a beautiful garden and a musical fountain.

entries.name: Gandhi Memorial Museum
entries.description: A museum in Madurai housed in the historic palace of Rani Mangammal that displays relics, freedom struggle history, and items related to Mahatma Gandhi.

entries.name: Koodal Azhagar Temple
entries.description: A popular pilgrimage temple located in Madurai city known for its brilliant architecture and design.

entries.name: Meenakshi Amman Temple
entries.description: A historic Hindu temple located in Madurai dedicated to Lord Sundareswarar and Goddess Meenakshi, featuring 14 towering gopurams decorated with intricate, vibrantly coloured carvings.

entries.name: Samanar Hills
entries.description: An ancient Jain settlement and protected monument located near Madurai featuring hill caves with elaborate carvings, drawings, and 2,200-year-old Tamil-Brahmi inscriptions.

entries.name: Arthur's Seat
entries.description: A prominent viewpoint situated at an elevation of 1,470 meters, offering panoramic views of the Savitri Valley and Brahma-Arayana Valley.

entries.name: Mahabaleshwar Temple
entries.description: An ancient 16th-century temple dedicated to Lord Shiva, known for its intricate Maratha architecture and spiritual significance.

entries.name: Pratapgarh Fort
entries.description: A majestic and historically significant hill fort associated with Shivaji Maharaj, located near Mahabaleshwar.

entries.name: Venna Lake
entries.description: A popular body of water and major tourist attraction in Mahabaleshwar ideal for scenic visits and boating activities.

entries.name: Hidimba Devi Temple
entries.description: A historic wooden shrine nestled in cedar forests, dedicated to Hidimbi Devi, the wife of Bhima from the Mahabharata.

entries.name: Manu Temple
entries.description: A pagoda-style temple rising on a hill near Old Manali, honoring Sage Manu and offering sweeping views of the valley below.

entries.name: Rohtang Pass
entries.description: A high mountain pass offering stunning scenic views and requiring a special permit for visitors traveling from Manali.

entries.name: Solang Valley
entries.description: A vast valley covered with grass, azure skies, and breathtaking views, known as a popular destination for adventure activities and winter snow.

entries.name: Panambur Beach
entries.description: A well-known golden-sand beach in Mangaluru offering thrilling water sports and scenic coastal views.

entries.name: St. Aloysius Chapel
entries.description: A 19th-century landmark in Mangaluru adorned with breathtaking and historic frescos.

entries.name: Sultan Battery
entries.description: A historic watchtower in Mangaluru situated along the coast that whispers tales of the past.

entries.name: Tannirbhavi Beach
entries.description: A serene beach in Mangaluru known for its tranquil ambiance and a nearby tree park providing green respite.

entries.name: Dwarkadhish Temple
entries.description: A revered architectural marvel dating back to 1814 where Lord Krishna is worshipped in his majestic adult form.

entries.name: Mathura Government Museum
entries.description: A museum located at Dampier Park housing a vast collection of ancient relics, sculptures, coins, and paintings from the Mathura school of art.

entries.name: Shri Krishna Janmabhoomi Temple
entries.description: The spiritual heart of Mathura, believed to mark the exact spot where Lord Krishna was born in a prison cell.

entries.name: Vishram Ghat
entries.description: A prominent waterfront ghat along the Yamuna River where Lord Krishna rested after Kansa's defeat, featuring evening aartis and boat rides.

entries.name: Elephanta Caves
entries.description: Ancient rock-cut temples located on an island near Mumbai, featuring detailed carvings and sculptures representing early artistic and religious traditions.

entries.name: Gateway of India
entries.description: An iconic landmark stone archway located on the waterfront in Colaba, built in 1911 to welcome the King and Queen of England.

entries.name: Global Vipassana Pagoda
entries.description: A warm and inviting spiritual centre and serene meditation hall built to increase harmony and acquaint people with Buddha's teachings.

entries.name: Siddhivinayak Temple
entries.description: The most revered Lord Ganesh temple in Maharashtra, located in Prabhadevi, Mumbai, and known as a deeply significant religious site.

entries.name: Eravikulam National Park
entries.description: A major national park near Munnar covering 97 square kilometers, known for its high-altitude scenery, trekking opportunities, and as the natural habitat of the endangered Nilgiri Tahr.

entries.name: Kannan Devan Tea Museum
entries.description: Located in Munnar, this museum depicts the journey of the tea industry, featuring vintage machinery, photographs, and insights into tea processing.

entries.name: Mattupetty Dam
entries.description: A popular dam and picnic spot located near Munnar offering a scenic landscape, boating options, and surrounding tea plantations.

entries.name: Top Station
entries.description: Located around 32 km from Munnar, Top Station is the highest point in the area, offering panoramic views of the Western Ghats and valleys in Tamil Nadu.

entries.name: Company Garden
entries.description: A landscaped park and major picnic location in Mussoorie featuring a boating lake, picnic areas, and rides for families.

entries.name: Kempty Falls
entries.description: A popular waterfall in Mussoorie where visitors can swim, picnic, and relax amidst lush greenery and high mountain cliffs.

entries.name: Lal Tibba Scenic Point
entries.description: A scenic viewpoint in Mussoorie offering tranquil surroundings, stunning vistas, and views with the help of binoculars.

entries.name: Sir George Everest's House
entries.description: The former residence and laboratory of the British surveyor after whom Mount Everest was named, offering historical importance and breathtaking views.

entries.name: Jaganmohan Palace Art Gallery And Auditorium
entries.description: A historic palace in Mysuru that now functions as an art gallery and auditorium showcasing regional culture and history.

entries.name: Mysuru Palace
entries.description: An architectural masterpiece and former royal residence that blends Indo-Saracenic, Rajput, Islamic, and Gothic styles, serving as one of India's most visited monuments.

entries.name: Regional Museum of Natural History
entries.description: A museum in Mysuru offering fascinating insights into Karnataka's rich ecological heritage.

entries.name: St. Philomena's Church
entries.description: One of the tallest churches in India, featuring a striking example of Neo-Gothic French architecture.

entries.name: Kalaram Temple
entries.description: A revered temple situated in the Panchvati area of Nashik, dedicated to Lord Rama and known for its black stone idols and intricately carved pillars.

entries.name: Pandavleni Caves
entries.description: A collection of 24 rock-cut Buddhist caves dating back to ancient times, perched on the Trirashmi Hills near Nashik and featuring intricate carvings and inscriptions.

entries.name: Sula Vineyards
entries.description: India's leading producer of wines located amidst the rolling hills of Nashik overlooking Gangapur Dam, offering winery tours, wine-tasting sessions, and restaurants.

entries.name: Trimbakeshwar Temple
entries.description: An ancient Hindu temple located near the Brahmagiri mountain in Nashik, dedicated to Lord Shiva as one of the twelve Jyotirlingas and associated with the origin of the Godavari River.

entries.name: Humayun's Tomb
entries.description: A renowned UNESCO World Heritage Site and Mughal-era architectural monument located in New Delhi.

entries.name: India Gate
entries.description: A prominent war memorial and colonial-era landmark located along the Kartavya path in New Delhi.

entries.name: Lotus Temple
entries.description: A modern architectural landmark and temple in New Delhi known for its distinctive marble petal design.

entries.name: Red Fort
entries.description: A historic Mughal-era fortress in New Delhi featuring prominent sandstone ramparts and rich historical context.

entries.name: Doddabetta Peak
entries.description: Set at a high altitude in the Nilgiris, Doddabetta Peak is a well-known viewpoint near Ooty providing sweeping panorama views.

entries.name: Government Botanical Garden
entries.description: Spread over a huge area with hundreds of species of flowers and trees, the Government Botanical Garden in Ooty is a popular horticulturist's delight.

entries.name: Nilgiri Mountain Railway
entries.description: A historic mountain railway offering a scenic and thrilling toy train ride through the Nilgiri Hills.

entries.name: Ooty Lake
entries.description: An artificially constructed lake built by John Sullivan in 1824, offering scenic boat rides amidst serene greenery.

entries.name: Chaturbhuj Temple
entries.description: A stunning sixteenth-century Hindu shrine located at the heart of Orchha, originally built to house a statue of Lord Rama and dedicated to Lord Vishnu.

entries.name: Jahangir Mahal
entries.description: A prominent palace within the Orchha Fort complex built to welcome Mughal Emperor Jahangir, showcasing a blend of Rajput and Mughal architecture.

entries.name: Orchha Fort
entries.description: An architectural marvel situated on an island at the confluence of the Betwa and Jamni Rivers, featuring palaces and structures like Jahangir Mahal and Raj Mahal.

entries.name: Ram Raja Temple
entries.description: A significant religious site and temple in Orchha where Lord Rama is worshipped as a king and guarded by a police force.

entries.name: Bee Falls
entries.description: A scenic waterfall in Pachmarhi surrounded by lush green forests that also provides drinking water to the entire town.

entries.name: Dhoopgarh
entries.description: The highest peak and vantage point in Pachmarhi, offering majestic sunrise and sunset views over the Satpura Range.

entries.name: Jata Shankar Cave
entries.description: A sacred cave temple dedicated to Lord Shiva featuring rock formations resembling matted dreadlocks and stalagmites shaped like Shivalingas.

entries.name: Satpura National Park
entries.description: A major tiger reserve and popular tourist attraction in Pachmarhi housing Bengal tigers, leopards, Indian bison, sloth bears, and various bird and plant species.

entries.name: Fontainhas
entries.description: A colorful colonial neighborhood in Panjim that serves as one of the only Latin Quarters in Asia.

entries.name: Mahalakshmi Temple
entries.description: A popular spiritual temple in Panaji dedicated to Goddess Mahalakshmi, featuring a unique brickwork Deepstambh.

entries.name: Maruti Temple
entries.description: An iconic temple dedicated to Lord Hanuman, situated atop a hill in Panaji with a bright orange facade.

entries.name: Our Lady of Immaculate Conception Church
entries.description: A prominent and historic church located in Panjim, known as a key landmark in the heart of the city.

entries.name: Dhom Dam
entries.description: A scenic lake offering boating, speedboat rides, and camping by the lakebanks for adventure seekers and nature lovers.

entries.name: Parsi Point
entries.description: A popular attraction offering wonderful views around the Krishna Valley, named because it was a favorite spot for the Parsi community.

entries.name: Rajpuri Caves
entries.description: Located about 10 km from Panchgani, these ancient caves house a temple of Lord Karthikeya and a local goddess, surrounded by holy ponds.

entries.name: Table Land
entries.description: The second longest mountain plateau in Asia, serving as a popular filming location known for its picturesque views of the valley.

entries.name: Anthropological Museum
entries.description: An ethnographic museum in Port Blair that showcases the indigenous tribes of the Andaman and Nicobar Islands.

entries.name: Cellular Jail
entries.description: An old colonial prison in Port Blair, also known as Kala Pani, used by the British to exile Indian political prisoners.

entries.name: Corbyn’s Cove Beach
entries.description: A popular beach in Port Blair known for boating, water scooters, and jet skiing.

entries.name: Sri Vetrimalai Murugan Temple
entries.description: A significant Hindu pilgrimage site in Port Blair dedicated to Lord Murugan, featuring Dravidian architecture.

entries.name: Basilica of the Sacred Heart of Jesus
entries.description: A prominent church in Puducherry featuring Gothic architecture and colourful stained glass artwork.

entries.name: Botanical Garden
entries.description: A botanical garden situated in the southwest of Puducherry city, known for its landscaped surroundings and rare plant species.

entries.name: Manakula Vinayagar Temple
entries.description: A historic Hindu temple situated in the Union Territory of Puducherry.

entries.name: Sri Aurobindo Ashram
entries.description: A well-known spiritual ashram located in Puducherry, featuring peaceful walking paths, a samadhi, and a bookshop.

entries.name: Aga Khan Palace
entries.description: A majestic historical palace in Pune built in 1892 that served as a prison for national leaders like Mahatma Gandhi during the Quit India Movement.

entries.name: Raja Dinkar Kelkar Museum
entries.description: An iconic museum in Pune established by Baba Dinkar Kelkar, housing over 15,000 objects including sculptures, musical instruments, weapons, and paintings.

entries.name: Shaniwar Wada
entries.description: A prominent historical landmark and majestic fortification in Pune built in 1732 that served as the seat of the Peshwas of the Maratha Empire.

entries.name: Sinhagad Fort
entries.description: A popular historic architectural landmark and fortress located near Pune, frequently visited for trekking and sightseeing.

entries.name: Gundicha Temple
entries.description: An important temple in Puri where the deities reside for seven days during the annual Ratha Yatra festival after being transported from the main Jagannath Temple.

entries.name: Raghurajpur Artist Village
entries.description: A famous heritage village located near Puri renowned for its traditional arts and crafts, including Pattachitra paintings, palm-leaf artwork, and Gotipua dance performances.

entries.name: Sri Jagannath Puri Temple
entries.description: A majestic 12th-century Vaishnava temple in Puri built by King Ananta Varman Chodaganga Deva, enshrining Lord Jagannath, Devi Subhadra, and Balabhadra as part of the sacred Char Dham sites.

entries.name: Sudarshan Crafts Museum
entries.description: Founded by sculptor Sudarsan Sahoo, this museum in Puri showcases Odisha's traditional arts and crafts, including stone and wood sculptures, metalwork, and terracotta art.

entries.name: Brahma Temple
entries.description: Also known as Jagatpita Brahma Mandir, this prominent 14th-century temple is dedicated to Lord Brahma and is one of the few existing temples dedicated to him.

entries.name: Pushkar Lake
entries.description: A sacred semi-circular lake surrounded by 52 bathing ghats and hundreds of temples, considered a major pilgrimage site.

entries.name: Savitri Temple
entries.description: A temple located high on a hilltop overlooking the town of Pushkar, offering views of the surrounding area.

entries.name: Varaha Temple
entries.description: The largest and most ancient temple in Pushkar, constructed by King Anaji Chauhan and dedicated to Lord Vishnu's wild boar incarnation.

entries.name: Dhanushkodi Beach Point
entries.description: A scenic beach point offering beautiful rides with the Bay of Bengal on one side and the Indian Ocean on the other.

entries.name: Dr. A. P. J. Abdul Kalam National Memorial
entries.description: A memorial museum dedicated to former Indian President Dr. A. P. J. Abdul Kalam, showcasing his life journey, achievements, and scientific contributions.

entries.name: Pamban Bridge
entries.description: A historic sea bridge and engineering marvel connecting Rameswaram island to the mainland of Tamil Nadu.

entries.name: Ramanathaswamy Temple
entries.description: A prominent Hindu temple dedicated to Lord Shiva, featuring magnificent corridors, intricately carved pillars, and one of the twelve Jyotirlingas.

entries.name: Chaubatia Garden
entries.description: A scenic garden near Ranikhet housing fruit research centers and vast orchards of apples, peaches, and apricots, offering panoramic views of the Himalayas.

entries.name: Haidakhan Babaji Temple
entries.description: A revered temple located in Chilianaula near Ranikhet, dedicated to Lord Shiva and established by Shri Haidakhan Maharaj, offering splendid views of the Himalayan peaks.

entries.name: Jhula Devi Temple
entries.description: An ancient temple dedicated to Goddess Durga, famous for its numerous bells and located close to Ranikhet.

entries.name: Kumaon Regimental Centre Museum
entries.description: A museum established in 1972 showcasing the heritage, history, weapons, and achievements of the Kumaon Regiment in Ranikhet.

entries.name: Laxman Jhula
entries.description: An iconic 450-foot iron suspension bridge spanning the river Ganges in Rishikesh.

entries.name: Neelkanth Mahadev Temple
entries.description: A prominent forest temple dedicated to Lord Shiva, located near Rishikesh.

entries.name: Ram Jhula
entries.description: A 450-foot suspension bridge crossing the sacred Ganges River in Rishikesh, connecting Muni Ki Reti with Swargashram.

entries.name: Triveni Ghat
entries.description: A sacred bathing spot on the banks of the Ganges River in Rishikesh where the Ganga aarti takes place.

entries.name: Don Bosco Museum
entries.description: A seven-story architectural landmark featuring seventeen galleries that offer insights into the indigenous cultures and history of Northeast India.

entries.name: Elephant Falls
entries.description: A picturesque three-tier cascade surrounded by lush greenery, named after the shape of a stone at its base that resembles an elephant.

entries.name: Lady Hydari Park
entries.description: A well-maintained garden located in the heart of Shillong, featuring beautiful flower beds, walking paths, and a mini zoo.

entries.name: Rhino Heritage Museum
entries.description: A unique museum located in Shillong dedicated to the conservation and preservation of the Indian rhinoceros, featuring informative exhibits and photographs.

entries.name: Christ Church
entries.description: Located on the Ridge, this prominent Neo-Gothic architectural landmark is one of the oldest churches in North India.

entries.name: Himachal State Museum
entries.description: A colonial building preserving cultural and archaeological artifacts, ancient historical sculptures, paintings, and coins from across the state.

entries.name: Jakhu Temple
entries.description: Situated atop Jakhu Hill, the highest peak in Shimla, this ancient temple dedicated to Lord Hanuman features a massive 108-foot statue and offers panoramic views.

entries.name: Viceregal Lodge
entries.description: Built in 1888 and now housing the Indian Institute of Advanced Study, this English Renaissance-style historic building features light blue limestone masonry and magnificent lawns.

entries.name: Dwarkamai
entries.description: A holy abode located beside the main temple that witnessed Sai Baba's divine presence for decades.

entries.name: Jangli Maharaj Ashram
entries.description: An ashram located near Shirdi named after the revered saint Jangli Maharaj, offering a sanctuary for meditation and spiritual growth.

entries.name: Sai Teerth Theme Park
entries.description: India's first devotional theme park featuring immersive shows, a 5D show, and attractions dedicated to the life and teachings of Sai Baba.

entries.name: Shirdi Sai Baba Temple
entries.description: A prominent temple complex spread over acres of land that surrounds the Divine Samadhi Temple where the body of Sai Baba is enshrined.

entries.name: Coronation Bridge
entries.description: A notable landmark in the Siliguri area spanning the river, known for its scenic views and architecture.

entries.name: Darjeeling Himalayan Railway
entries.description: A historic mountain railway connected with Siliguri, celebrated for its engineering and scenic route.

entries.name: Mahananda Wildlife Sanctuary
entries.description: A protected wildlife sanctuary located near Siliguri, providing a habitat for diverse flora and fauna.

entries.name: Salugara Monastery
entries.description: A prominent Buddhist monastery situated near Siliguri, known for its peaceful atmosphere and stupa.

entries.name: HNB Garhwal University Museum
entries.description: The HNB Garhwal University Museum in Srinagar, Uttarakhand, is a notable location for history and historical ruins.

entries.name: Kamleshwar Mahadev Temple
entries.description: Kamleshwar Mahadev Temple is one of the popular Shiva temples of the Garhwal region and is located in Srinagar town near its main market.

entries.name: Madhuri Lake
entries.description: Also known as Shonga-tser Lake, this high-altitude lake is surrounded by snow-capped mountains and lush greenery near Tawang.

entries.name: Sela Pass
entries.description: A high-altitude mountain pass sitting at approximately 4,176 meters above sea level, characterized by magnificent lakes and prayer flags.

entries.name: Tawang Monastery
entries.description: India's largest Buddhist monastery and the second-largest in the world, perched at an altitude of about 3,000 meters in Tawang, Arunachal Pradesh.

entries.name: Tawang War Memorial
entries.description: A memorial built in traditional Tibetan style that pays tribute to the Indian soldiers who lost their lives during the 1962 Indo-China War.

entries.name: Airavatesvara Temple
entries.description: A UNESCO World Heritage Shiva temple located near Thanjavur in Dharasuram, featuring intricate classical sculptures and chariot-shaped architecture.

entries.name: Brihadeeswara Temple
entries.description: Also known as the Big Temple, this UNESCO World Heritage Site was built by Raja Raja Chola I and is renowned for its intricate South Indian architecture and gigantic proportions.

entries.name: Saraswathi Mahal Library
entries.description: Located within the palace premises, this is one of the oldest manuscript libraries in the world, preserving age-old manuscripts, maps, paintings, and artifacts.

entries.name: Thanjavur Palace
entries.description: The historical palace and fort complex used by the Maratha kings, featuring attractions within its premises such as the durbar hall and Nayak Hall.

entries.name: Napier Museum
entries.description: A historic heritage landmark and architectural masterpiece built in an Indo-Saracenic style, located right in the heart of Thiruvananthapuram city.

entries.name: Sree Padmanabhaswamy Temple
entries.description: An iconic, ancient temple dedicated to Lord Vishnu, known for housing the deity in an eternal yogic sleep posture and recognized as one of the wealthiest temples in the world.

entries.name: Thiruvananthapuram Zoo
entries.description: One of the oldest zoos in India, situated within a sprawling 55-acre complex and featuring naturalistic enclosures for its animals alongside public gardens.

entries.name: Athirappilly Waterfalls
entries.description: Located in Thrissur district on the Chalakudi River, it is the largest waterfall in Kerala, often referred to as the 'Niagara of India'.

entries.name: Shakthan Thampuran Palace
entries.description: A historical palace located in the heart of Thrissur city, reconstructed in 1795 with a blend of Kerala and Dutch architecture, currently housing a museum with artifacts and royal memorabilia.

entries.name: Thrissur Zoo and State Museum
entries.description: Established in 1855, it is one of the oldest zoological parks in the country and is located in Chembukavvu within Thrissur, housing an archaeological museum with a vast collection of antiquities.

entries.name: Vadakkunnathan Temple
entries.description: An ancient temple dedicated to Lord Shiva located in Thrissur, known for its stunning architecture, beautiful murals, and as the main venue for the Thrissur Pooram festival.

entries.name: Bhubaneswari Temple
entries.description: Located on the banks of the Gomati River, this historic temple is a sacred site and an architectural gem of Udaipur.

entries.name: Gunabati Group of Temples
entries.description: Built in the 17th century by Maharani Gunabati, these temples showcase the rich traditional temple architecture of Tripura.

entries.name: Kalyan Sagar
entries.description: A big, serene lake situated beside the Tripura Sundari Temple in Udaipur.

entries.name: Tripura Sundari Temple
entries.description: One of the 51 Shakti Peethas in India, this revered temple is dedicated to Goddess Kali and attracts pilgrims and travelers from across the country.

entries.name: Harsiddhi Temple
entries.description: A renowned Hindu temple and one of the 51 Shakti Peethas in India dedicated to Goddess Harsiddhi Mata.

entries.name: Jantar Mantar
entries.description: Also known as the Vedhshala, this astronomical observatory was built by Maharaja Jai Singh to aid in the research of celestial bodies.

entries.name: Kal Bhairav Temple
entries.description: A prominent and revered Hindu temple located in Ujjain dedicated to Lord Kal Bhairav.

entries.name: Mahakaleshwar Temple
entries.description: One of the 12 jyotirlingas in India, famous for its daily Bhasma aarti ritual where the Shiva linga is decorated with ash and offerings.

entries.name: EME Temple
entries.description: A unique temple dedicated to Lord Shiva in Vadodara, maintained by the Indian army and constructed using artistic aluminum sheets.

entries.name: Laxmi Vilas Palace
entries.description: The largest and most iconic palace in Vadodara, built in 1890 for the Maharajahs of Baroda with grand Indo-Saracenic architecture.

entries.name: Maharaja Fateh Singh Museum
entries.description: A museum founded in 1961 within the Laxmi Vilas Palace grounds in Vadodara, housing an extensive collection of international art and sculptures.

entries.name: Sayaji Baug
entries.description: A sprawling 113-acre historic public garden along the Vishwamitri River in Vadodara that houses a zoo, planetarium, and museums.

entries.name: Bharat Kala Bhavan Museum
entries.description: A museum located within the Banaras Hindu University campus in Varanasi featuring a vast collection of Indian paintings, Mughal miniatures, and sculptures.

entries.name: Dashashwamedh Ghat
entries.description: One of the holiest riverfront ghats in Varanasi on the Ganges, famous for its grand evening Ganga Aarti ceremony.

entries.name: Kashi Vishwanath Temple
entries.description: One of the twelve Jyotirlingas, dedicated to Lord Shiva, located in Varanasi and visited by millions of devotees each year.

entries.name: Sarnath Archaeological Museum
entries.description: The oldest archaeological museum in the country located in Sarnath near Varanasi, housing Buddhist antique pieces and the original Lion Capital of Ashoka.

entries.name: Janardhana Swamy Temple
entries.description: An ancient 2,000-year-old Hindu temple dedicated to Lord Vishnu, perched near the cliffs and renowned for its Dravidian architecture and cultural significance.

entries.name: Kappil Lake
entries.description: A serene estuary surrounded by lush coconut groves located a short distance north of Varkala, offering tranquil water views from a spanning bridge.

entries.name: Sivagiri Mutt
entries.description: A popular hilltop ashram and spiritual headquarters founded in 1904 by Sree Narayana Guru, featuring multi-tiered white terraces and his final resting place.

entries.name: Varkala Beach
entries.description: Also known as Papanasam Beach, this picturesque coastal destination features stunning red laterite cliffs overlooking the Arabian Sea and natural springs.

entries.name: Bogmalo Beach
entries.description: A popular sandy beach located a few kilometers from Vasco da Gama, known for its scenic views, beach-side restaurants, and water sports.

entries.name: Japanese Garden
entries.description: A tranquil and serene garden located in Mormugao near Vasco da Gama, featuring lush greenery, sculptures, and a peaceful spot to unwind.

entries.name: Naval Aviation Museum
entries.description: A military aviation museum located in Bogmalo near Vasco da Gama, showcasing the history of the Indian Naval Air Arm with aircraft displays and artifacts.

entries.name: St. Andrew's Church
entries.description: An historic church in Vasco da Gama founded by the Jesuits centuries ago, known as a prominent architectural and religious landmark.

entries.name: Banke Bihari Temple
entries.description: A famous temple in Vrindavan dedicated to Lord Krishna in his Banke Bihari form, known for its beautiful idol, lively atmosphere during festivals, and unique darshan traditions.

entries.name: ISKCON Temple
entries.description: Also known as the Sri Krishna-Balarama Temple, this spiritual haven in Vrindavan was built by ISKCON and features deities of Sri Sri Gaura Nitai, Krishna Balaram, and Radha Shyamasundar.

entries.name: Keshi Ghat
entries.description: One of the main ghats of Vrindavan located along the river, popular for early morning visits and scenic heritage views.

entries.name: Prem Mandir
entries.description: Also known as the temple of love, this large two-story marble temple complex in Vrindavan is dedicated to Lord Krishna and Radha, featuring carved domes, pillars, and evening illumination.

entries.name: Banasura Sagar Dam
entries.description: A prominent tourist attraction in Wayanad known for its scenic beauty and surrounding landscape.

entries.name: Edakkal Caves
entries.description: Natural prehistoric caves featuring exquisite wall and rock carvings, making it one of the popular tourist attractions in Wayanad.

entries.name: Thirunelli Temple
entries.description: An ancient temple dedicated to Lord Maha Vishnu, set amidst lush forests and the Brahmagiri Hills, often referred to as the 'Kashi of the South'.
